title: IS 14543:2016 — Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
content: Indian Standard for packaged drinking water other than natural mineral water. According to BIS, the standard specifies limits for physical parameters (such as TDS and turbidity), microbiological parameters (such as E. coli, yeast and mould), chemical parameters (such as pH), and pesticide and radioactive residue levels. Packaged drinking water is under compulsory BIS certification under the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulation, 2011. BIS titles the standard "Packaged Drinking Water (other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification". A 2024 revision of IS 14543 may exist; this record cites the 2016 edition described on the BIS blog. Catalogue title: "Packaged Drinking Water Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water  Specification Third Revision". Catalogue title source: BIS's own Know Your Standards catalogue (services.bis.gov.in), read without a login. The standard document itself is sold by BIS.
